content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue where a PLC program file in [product_name] [version_no] opens without requesting a diagram password in [version_no], but in [version_no] it asks for one. I need to use [version_no] to transfer the program to the controller device.
Could you please upload the program file as a ZIP? If you prefer not to share it publicly, you can send the ZIP file via private message.

It seems a password was previously set for this project and then removed, but some parameter remains in the structure. When you try to open it with [version_no], it prompts for a password again. Try opening the project, enter the password in [version_no], then delete the password and save it as a new program.
I've never encountered a situation where older program files without a diagram password are suddenly password-protected in [product_name] [version_no].

I had a case where a controller was password protected, preventing program retrieval. We asked the machine builder for the program. Using [product_name] [version_no], the program opened fine. After updating to [version_no], the program now requires a password and can't be opened.
I agree; I have not seen this before.

When I try to open the project in [version_no], I must enter a password before accessing the project, which is challenging. Opening it in [version_no] still requires the old password to change or remove it, and then save it before using it in [version_no].

This behavior appears to be a bug in [product_name] [version_no]. I tested creating a program in [version_no], enabling and then removing password protection, and saving it. In [version_no], it opens without a password. In [version_no], it asks for the password. Consider submitting a support request.
If you can't remember the password, upload the controller program or send it to me directly and I'll try to help recover it.

In the German forum on the account '[product_name] Support,' it was posted that in [product_name] [version_no], this password behavior is an intentional feature according to the development team. Projects protected with a password can only be accessed in [version_no] if the correct password is entered.
Hi, could I get help opening a diagram in [version_no]? I'm now prompted for a password. Thank you. I've uploaded the diagram file to a free host since I couldn't attach it here. [document]
Next time, please create a ZIP archive of the file and attach the ZIP instead of using a file server.
Hello [user_name], your file is protected with a diagram password. Without the password, it can't be opened.
No, it's not possible to open the file without the password.

analysis.insight_summary: Multiple users report unexpected password prompts with [product_name] [version_no] when opening project files that were previously accessible in older versions. This disruption is seen as either a bug or a confusing new feature, particularly when password protection was already removed. Clear communication and consistent behavior about password handling between software versions remain key concerns and sources of frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect both backward and forward compatibility across different [product_name] versions, especially after removing password protection in previous releases. They want a seamless process for opening, editing, and transferring PLC programs in [version_no] without needing old passwords.
